text:
Ivan Barbashev has turned into a passer this season. He has 13 points in 19 games and 11 of them are assists, and Vegas has been dominant with him on the ice: 59.6% of the five-on-five expected goals, 9.5 points better than without him.

His own shooting has gone cold. Two goals on 24 shots is 8.3%, well below his usual and the league's 13%. That's the part of his season most likely to change. His teammates, on the other hand, have finished a bit better than their chances with him on the ice, so the assists may cool as his goals warm up.

The two-time Cup winner was one of the league's better forwards last season by Evolving-Hockey's numbers (2.2 wins above replacement, 42nd of 401), helped by strong linemates and a knack for drawing penalties. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him living on the receiving end of passes across the slot. At 30 he's exactly what Vegas wants on the second line. Our range: around 56 points.
headline: Ivan Barbashev is setting the table in Vegas
